verdict.rationale: Paddle's AI offering connects external agents (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) to the account through a hosted MCP server, a docs MCP server and agent skills. The evidence never shows an assistant built into Paddle itself, such as in the dashboard, that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP tooling is an adjacent capability for third-party agents, so it earns no credit for a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Paddle MCP server lets AI agents interact with your Paddle account.
Connect AI agents like Claude and Cursor directly to Paddle to work through complex flows in seconds.
